title: Multi-horizon forecasting of national electricity demand in Türkiye: run records, forecasts and trained models (Zenodo record)
note: Zenodo dataset v1.0 by Abdulhalik Oguz, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23143335, CC-BY-4.0, supplement to the GitHub repository. Holds 759 training runs (contract, metrics, validation and sealed test forecasts, trained models), per-origin loss series, bootstrap draws and raw weather downloads in 40 files. The description states no models, horizons, dates or accuracy numbers.

title: README.txt of Zenodo record 23143335
note: Layout note: 37 run archives (TCN 17, NeuralForecast 7, foundation 7, recurrent/LightGBM/linear/naive 6), an analysis archive and raw Open-Meteo files. LightGBM boosters and NeuralForecast checkpoints (10.3 GB) are not included; some manifests were edited after the freeze and the originals kept. Data CC BY 4.0, code MIT. No results, horizons or paper status.

title: ahalikoguz/turkiye-electricity-demand-forecasting (repository README)
note: Code and data for an unpublished paper by Cetin, Saglam and Oguz (citation to be added on publication; no preprint link). National hourly consumption from EPIAS 2016-2025; forecasts 1, 24, 168 and 720 h ahead from every hour of 2025; trained on 2016-2023, models selected on 2024. Code MIT. results/runs.csv has validation and test metrics of 759 runs. The README reports no accuracy figure.

title: README.md (raw)
note: Checksums of data and configuration are verified before any computation. The current release edited comments and docstrings only; run ids hash the code without comments so they are unchanged, but evaluate would now need a new freeze. Trained TCN, recurrent and Chronos-2 LoRA models are on Zenodo; LightGBM and NeuralForecast models on request.

title: Commit list of the repository
note: Two commits only: 6179be4 on 2026-10-04 18:36 UTC (code, data and results together) and 66ed2f4 on 2026-10-26 (README: Zenodo link and model availability). Nothing public is dated before the results, so the freeze before the test cannot be checked from git history.

title: File tree of the repository
note: 37 files: configs (analysis_plan.json, experiments.yaml, frozen.json, selected.yaml), the raw EPIAS export, processed hourly load, province temperatures and temperature forecasts, an Open-Meteo manifest, results/runs.csv, four scripts and tests. No paper, no results note.

title: configs/analysis_plan.json
note: Plan stamped 2026-09-30 15:12 UTC, said to be written on the 2024 validation year before freeze and evaluate. Primary loss: absolute percentage error per hourly origin, averaged over leads and seeds; paired moving-block bootstrap, 95% interval, 10,000 draws, block max(2H,168) h; Holm over primary comparisons. No decision threshold.

title: configs/analysis_plan.json
note: Primary comparisons centre the authors' TCN: at H=24 and H=168, LightTCN_large against Chronos-2 with LoRA (both calendar inputs) plus two attention read-out contrasts; at H=1 against NHITS; at H=720 against CNN-LSTM and PatchTST. Zero-shot Chronos-2, TimesFM 3 and TiRex-2, LightGBM and NHITS appear in secondary information contrasts.

title: configs/analysis_plan.json
note: Information contrasts (secondary): F0 to F1 target-hour calendar; F1 to F1A holiday analog; F1 to F2 past temperature; F2 to F3 bias-corrected forecast temperature of the target hours; F3 against F3_diag (observed instead of forecast future temperature) and against F4 (oracle weather scenario); a 12 h instead of 24 h forecast vintage margin. No foundation-model revisions are given.

title: configs/experiments.yaml
note: Model grid: TCN variants, LSTM/BiLSTM/CNN-LSTM, NeuralForecast (NHITS, TimeXer, PatchTST, iTransformer), zero-shot Chronos2, TimesFM3, TiRex2, Chronos2_LoRA fine-tuned on 2016-2023, LightGBM, naive baselines, and Vanilla / Vanilla_holiday (a Hong-style regression without load lags). Horizons 1, 24, 168, 720 h. No Hugging Face ids or revisions.

title: configs/frozen.json
note: Freeze record 82ae200eeb698f4b stamped 2026-09-30 15:13 UTC: SHA-256 of experiments.yaml, selected.yaml, the three scripts, the load and weather data, and a hash per run (about 500 runs). No git commit, no test period, no model revisions. The timestamp is self-recorded in the file.

title: data/SOURCES.md
note: Load: EPIAS real-time consumption, hourly, 2016-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Temperature: ERA5 via the Open-Meteo historical API for 81 province capitals, population-weighted (2022 census); archived ECMWF IFS 0.25 forecasts via the Open-Meteo Previous Runs API, issued 1 to 7 days before valid time, 2024-2025 only, stored per lead, bias-corrected per province. Checksums for every download.

Validation (2024) F3 is 3.758. Read through fetch summaries in four chunks.

title: results/runs.csv
